title: Sundt-Hansen's 'Burial At Sea'
content: Norwegian painterKarl Sundt-Hansendepicted a somber scene aboard a ship after the death of a sailor.Karl Sundt-Hansen(1841-1907)Burial at Sea,1890A foreshortened body lies shrouded under a flag, while his bareheaded shipmates gather around. At the head of the body, a bearded man reads prayers as his widow quietly mourns.Their faces, captured in various shades of grief, explore a range of human characters and tell a story of shared mourning and stoic acceptance.
